meta.scope: Exact rational optimization on saved finite-game binary64 weights against the fixed public upper-script opponent. Positive gains reject only that script at stated phase/discount; zero recorded gains establish no general equilibrium. Profit discounting and separately certified undiscounted all-policy welfare are distinct. No learning, emergent collusion, empirical market or human-play validation.
meta.developmentAssistance: Codex development and AI-agent auditing assistance disclosed; no experimental model game player.
meta.provenance: Full descriptive export regenerated read-only against all independently audited raw evidence. Each new-K game-core welfare certificate matches its exact independently audited cycle/prefix certificate. Stored all-state phase argmax bytes are embedded, not optimized in the browser.
